3 | min_version = 4.0  # Require 4.0+ for proper pyproject.toml support

5 | [testenv]
6 | passenv = CI, CIRCLECI, CIRCLE_*, HOME, SQLFLUFF_BENCHMARK_API_KEY
7 | # Have option to explicitly set TMPDIR for python as on GitHub Action Windows
8 | # machines it doesn't read this from env and resets to system default, which
9 | # is often on different drive (C) from working dir (D), which causes problems.
10 | setenv =
11 |     SQLFLUFF_TESTENV = 1
12 |     COVERAGE_FILE = .coverage.{envname}
13 |     winpy: TMPDIR = temp_pytest
14 | allowlist_externals =
15 |     make
16 | pip_pre = false
17 | # Ensure pip is available in venvs when using tox-uv
18 | uv_seed = true
19 | # tox-uv infers base_python from env names. Without an explicit interpreter,
20 | # dbt180/dbt190 are parsed as dbt1.80/dbt1.90 and env creation fails.
21 | base_python =
22 |     py39: python3.9

36 | deps =
37 |     -r requirements_dev.txt
38 |     # Apply the constraints files _as requirements_ files here so that
39 |     # we force the right installation version up front in each environment.
40 |     # NOTE: This is a bit of a hack around tox, but it does achieve reasonably
41 |     # consistent results.
42 |     dbt{170,180,190,1100}: -r constraints/{envname}.txt
43 | # Include any other steps necessary for testing below.
44 | # {posargs} is there to allow us to specify specific tests, which
45 | # can then be invoked from tox by calling e.g.
46 | # tox -e py35 -- project/tests/test_file.py::TestClassName::test_method
47 | commands =
48 |     # Install the plugins as required.
49 |     # NOTE: We do them here, so that when version numbers update, we don't
50 |     # get install errors for version conflicts. The dbt templater has a version
51 |     # number pinned to the same version number of the main sqlfluff library
52 |     # so it _must_ be installed second in the context of a version which isn't
53 |     # yet released (and so not available on pypi).
54 |     dbt{170,180,190,1100}: python -m pip install "{toxinidir}/plugins/sqlfluff-templater-dbt"
55 |     # Add the example plugin.
56 |     # NOTE: The trailing comma is important because in the github test suite
57 |     # the python version is not specified and instead the "py" or "winpy"
58 |     # environment is invoked. Leaving the trailing comma ensures that this
59 |     # environment still installs the relevant plugins.
60 |     {py,winpy}{310,311,312,313,314,}: python -m pip install "{toxinidir}/plugins/sqlfluff-plugin-example"
61 |     rust: python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps --no-index --find-links="{toxinidir}/dist" sqlfluffrs
62 |     # Clean up from previous tests
63 |     python "{toxinidir}/util.py" clean-tests
